legalDisclaimer.title: Estimating Disclaimer & Limitation of Liability
legalDisclaimer.subtitle: Important Terms of Use, Non-Warranty, and Liability Limitations for Contractors & Estimators
legalDisclaimer.s1Body: Takeoff Engine provides computational tools and automated quantity processing designed to assist construction contractors, estimators, and engineers. All calculations, pricing summaries, trench earthwork models, rate applications, and export documents generated by this software are estimates only. Takeoff Engine does NOT provide architectural, structural, civil engineering, surveying, legal, or licensed professional consulting services. We do NOT guarantee the mathematical completeness, pricing sufficiency, profitability, or bidding success of any estimate produced.
legalDisclaimer.s2Body: The user (contractor, subcontractor, or estimator) maintains sole and exclusive responsibility for verifying all project dimensions, quantities, specifications, and costs prior to submitting any bid, executing any contract, or ordering construction materials. Specifically, users acknowledge and agree that:
legalDisclaimer.s2Item1: Plan & Specification Review: The user is solely responsible for cross-referencing all takeoff quantities against complete engineering plan sets, geotechnical soil reports, addenda, and project project specifications.
legalDisclaimer.s2Item2: Subsurface & Geotechnical Conditions: Soil excavation volumes, trench depths, swell/shrinkage factors, and rock/water classifications must be verified by field borings and local conditions. Takeoff Engine's trench calculations are geometric estimations and do not account for subsurface rock, unlocatable utilities, or adverse trenching collapse.
legalDisclaimer.s2Item3: Material & Labor Price Volatility: Material costs, supplier quotes, fuel surcharges, labor wage escalations, and regional market volatility must be independently confirmed with local suppliers and trade unions before bid submission.
legalDisclaimer.s2Item4: Scope Completeness & Exclusions: Missing scope badges, unmapped items, and placeholder tokens (TBD, HOLD, N/A) must be reviewed manually. The software does not verify whether all bid requirements or drawing details are fully captured.
legalDisclaimer.s3Body: Takeoff Engine is provided on an "AS-IS" and "AS-AVAILABLE" basis without warranties of any kind, whether express, statutory, or implied. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Takeoff Engine disclaims all warranties, including but not limited to implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular construction purpose, accuracy of algorithms, system uptime, and non-infringement.
legalDisclaimer.s4Body: Under no circumstances shall Takeoff Engine, its creators, founders, developers, officers, or affiliates be held liable for any damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, this platform or the estimates generated herein, including but not limited to:
legalDisclaimer.s4Item1: Direct or Indirect Bidding Losses: Underbidding, lost contractor profits, liquidated damages, bid bond forfeiture, project cost overruns, or rejected project bids.
legalDisclaimer.s4Item2: Material Shortages or Excesses: Over-ordering, material shortfalls, supplier restocking fees, or delivery delays resulting from takeoff quantity discrepancies.
legalDisclaimer.s4Item3: Maximum Liability Cap: In all jurisdictions where limitations of liability are enforceable, Takeoff Engine's aggregate liability for any and all claims shall not exceed the total amount paid by the user to Takeoff Engine for platform access in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, or $100.00 USD, whichever is less.
legalDisclaimer.s5Title: Third-Party Data, Software Integrations & User Spreadsheet Inputs
legalDisclaimer.s5Body: Takeoff Engine ingests data from third-party sources (including Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, HeavyBid, Trimble/Agtek, CSV, and Excel spreadsheets). Takeoff Engine is not responsible for corrupt formulas, hidden rows, improper unit conventions, mislabeled columns, or erroneous measurements present in user-uploaded source files.
legalDisclaimer.s6Title: Client Proposals, Electronic Signatures & Binding Contracts
legalDisclaimer.s6Body: Proposals and agreements generated through Takeoff Engine are draft commercial documents created at the direction of the contractor. Contractors and clients are strongly advised to have all construction contracts, payment milestones, scope inclusions, and indemnification clauses reviewed by licensed legal counsel prior to formal execution.

usagePolicy.title: Acceptable Use & Account Policy
usagePolicy.subtitle: Fair Operating Standards for Takeoff Engine Services
usagePolicy.s1Body: Takeoff Engine provides commercial estimating, bidding, and quantity takeoff tools for construction contractors, estimators, engineers, and developers. This Acceptable Use Policy establishes the standards required of all users to ensure a safe, secure, reliable, and professional business environment. By accessing or using Takeoff Engine, you agree to comply with this policy. Violations may result in immediate account suspension, permanent termination, or restriction of platform access.
usagePolicy.s2Intro: To protect platform performance and security for all estimators, the following abusive actions are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate suspension:
usagePolicy.s2Item1: Excessive API flooding, automated scraping, denial-of-service attempts, or deliberate overload of calculation and PDF generation services.
usagePolicy.s2Item2: Attempting to bypass trial metering, role access controls, organization seat limits, billing checks, or authentication barriers.
usagePolicy.s2Item3: Reverse engineering, unauthorized decompilation, or attempting to extract proprietary calculation engines, formulas, or system algorithms.
usagePolicy.s2Item4: Account credential sharing outside of authorized organization seat allocations or facilitating unauthorized third-party access.
usagePolicy.s2Item5: Uploading malicious files, exploit payloads, malicious scripts, or corrupted spreadsheet data intended to compromise server infrastructure.
usagePolicy.s3Intro: Takeoff Engine is a professional B2B platform designed for civil, utility, and general construction trade professionals.
usagePolicy.s3Body: We maintain straightforward, fair, and common-sense standards for all communications, proposal notes, team workspace interactions, and client correspondence. Discrimination, harassment, or abusive conduct will not be tolerated.
usagePolicy.s3Item1: Unlawful Discrimination: Unlawful discrimination, denial of services, or abusive harassment directed toward clients, subcontractors, vendors, or team members based on race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, or veteran status in any proposal, comment, email, or transmitted communication.
usagePolicy.s3Item2: Harassment & Threats: Threatening, defamatory, vulgar, or abusive language, extortion, or intimidation in client proposals, contract terms, project notes, or platform messaging.
usagePolicy.s3Item3: Fraudulent or Deceptive Conduct: Knowingly transmitting fraudulent bid packages, forged signatures, or deceptive proposals intended to mislead owners, general contractors, or public agencies.
usagePolicy.s3Item4: Inappropriate & Prohibited Imagery: Uploading, storing, or transmitting inappropriate photos, logos, avatars, project attachments, or media containing sexually explicit content, nudity, gratuitous violence, hate symbols, or copyrighted imagery without authorization. Company logos and project attachments must strictly adhere to professional construction and engineering standards.
usagePolicy.s4Body1: We reserve the right to investigate reported or detected violations of this policy. Depending on the severity and frequency of the violation, Takeoff Engine may issue formal warnings, temporarily suspend account access, revoke organization seats, or permanently terminate account privileges without refund.
usagePolicy.s4Body2: In cases involving malicious platform attacks, illegal activities, or severe fraudulent conduct, accounts may be terminated immediately without prior notice, and relevant data may be referred to appropriate authorities if required by law.
usagePolicy.s5Body: If you observe abuse of the system or communications violating these standards, or have questions regarding these terms, please contact our administrative team through your account settings or support portal.
